title: Water's Edge Boat Club
specs: Members pay annual membership dues and for fuel
Membership is active for one full year from date of purchase
includes: Boating accessories including life jackets, anchor, ropes, tubes
blurb: Members choose from several annual membership packages that provide unlimited boating access during the season. Reservations are made via a mobile app with limits on concurrent bookings depending on membership. Boating accessories are provided, and fuel is paid separately by members.
extraNote: Membership fee must be paid in full upfront by check or credit card; credit card payments include a 3% convenience fee · Fuel is not included in membership dues; prepaid fuel plans are available separately · Smokey’s Muskie Shop N27 W27250 Woodland Drive Pewaukee, WI 53072 or Hollywood’s Roadhouse Bar & Grill W332 N6629 County Rd C Nashotah, WI 53058 · May 1st – October 1st
